en.headline: State Council removes Ho Wing-yin as Housing Bureau Secretary
en.dek: The formal removal follows her resignation last week to take political responsibility for the Tai Po fire, with Michael Wong acting in the post.
body: The State Council of China has decided to remove Ho Wing-yin from her post as Secretary for Housing, according to an announcement by Xinhua News Agency on Tuesday.

The decision, made under the Basic Law on the recommendation of Chief Executive John Lee, takes effect immediately. Ho had resigned on 28 October, saying she was prepared to accept political responsibility for the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po.

Lee accepted the resignation the following day and appointed Financial Secretary’s Deputy Michael Wong as acting Secretary for Housing. He later wished Ho well in her future endeavours, noting her work on Light Public Housing and shortening public rental housing waiting times during her tenure.
The independent inquiry into the Tai Po fire, which killed 168 people last November, submitted its report last month. Authorities have pledged reforms to building maintenance and safety.

zh.headline: 國務院決定免去何永賢房屋局局長職務
zh.dek: 何永賢上月為大埔宏福苑火災承擔政治責任請辭，財政司副司長黃偉綸兼任署理局長。
body: 新華社周二報道，國務院依照《基本法》有關規定，根據行政長官李家超的建議，決定免去何永賢的房屋局局長職務，即日起生效。
何永賢於10月28日向李家超提出請辭，表示願意為宏福苑火災承擔政治責任。李家超翌日接納辭職，並委任財政司副司長黃偉綸兼任署理房屋局局長。
李家超其後祝願何永賢事事順遂、生活健康，並肯定她任內推動簡約公屋、縮短公屋輪候時間等工作。何永賢1992年加入政府，2022年出任房屋局局長。
宏福苑大火去年11月造成168人死亡，獨立調查委員會上月提交報告。政府已承諾進行建築維修及安全改革。
